sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is a canonical expected-result, comparison, owner-path, direct-check, or tolerance term; the supplied candidates represent bulbous-bow presence and the IA Super controlled value only.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The applicable IA Super/no-bulb branch only requires decimal C1 and C2 quantities in newtons; it does not satisfy the semantic obligation to validate those derived results with numerical tolerance. Add an approved tolerance comparison for both C1 and C2, with tolerance scaled from each expected formula result rather than the reported value, while preserving the current applicability and positive L/B/T checks.
